aid.title: Middlebury — Apply for Aid: First-Year and Transfer Students

test_policy.notes: Test optional. Scores may be self-reported at application; ACT science section not required.

requirements.notes: Application is free beginning with the 2026-27 cycle. Use the essay prompts on the Common App/Coalition application; no supplemental essay. Request at least two teacher recommendations. Alumni interview is optional and may be requested after applying (not guaranteed); Glimpse video is the alternative; InitialView/Vericant interviews (paid) also accepted. Applicants may state a preference for September entry, February entry (a 'Feb') or either. CSS Profile (code 3526) required of aid applicants; international applicants must file it online and apply for aid at the time of admission application.

deadlines.label: Early Decision I
deadlines.notes: Decision mid-December (no exact date published). Aid forms due Nov 15 (CSS Profile).

deadlines.label: Early Decision II
deadlines.notes: Decision mid-February (no exact date published). Admissions page lists Jan 4; the financial aid page lists Jan 3, 2027 for the aid forms.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Decision late March (no exact date published). Aid forms due Feb 1, 2027.

english_policy.waiver_notes: No English proficiency score is needed if your native language is English or your high-school classes were taught entirely in English for the last 3-4 years. All other applicants need verifiable TOEFL iBT, Duolingo English Test, IELTS or Cambridge English results. The page calls the scores below 'recommended' minimums.

aid.notes: Need-aware in admission of international students; international students seeking aid must apply for it when they apply for admission. Middlebury meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students. CSS Profile (code 3526) required; the ISFAA and paper CSS Profile are not accepted. The pages checked describe need-based aid only; merit awards not confirmed.
